name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: The page-navigation bar: a `<nav aria-label="pagination">` of anchor links with previous / next / ellipsis parts. It is presentation only — it computes no page numbers and knows no total.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/pagination

Installed to `components/ui/pagination.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/pagination';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/pagination

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
